definitions.gloss: sneaking a taste; nibbling; pilfering food
definitions.explanation: Secretly eating small amounts of food, especially before a meal is ready or from food that isn't meant for you.
Figuratively, trying things only partially or selectively without committing to any one thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つまみ{食|ぐ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I snuck a taste while cooking.

examples.english: I got scolded when I was caught sneaking bites of the cake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つまみ{食|ぐ}い⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Rather than cherry-picking information, you should study systematically.

notes:
From ⟦つまむ→つまむ：10374_tsumamu⟧ (to pinch/pick) + {食|く}い (eating). The image is of pinching small pieces of food and popping them in your mouth. Can be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a suru-verb. The literal sense is playful and relatable, while the figurative sense carries a mildly critical tone about lacking depth or commitment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つまみ{食|ぐ}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sneak a taste; to nibble
- つまみ{食|ぐ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧: to get caught sneaking food
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つまみ{食|ぐ}い: superficial sampling of knowledge
- つまみ{食|ぐ}い⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧: only dabbling level

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{味見|あじみ}→味見：08158_ajimi⟧: tasting; sampling — done openly and with purpose (e.g., a cook tasting a dish); no sneaking implied
- ⟦{試食|ししょく}→試食：03060_shishoku⟧: food sampling — formally offered samples at a store
- {盗|ぬす}み{食|ぐ}い: stealing food — more serious than つまみ{食|ぐ}い
